caption:
Apple is reportedly planning a product launch event for October 13.

Apple is reportedly gearing up to launch three new products next week, according to a report citing Mark Gurman.

The unveiling is expected to take place at a dedicated "event" on October 13.

While specific product details remain unconfirmed, the timing suggests these could be the highly anticipated new iPads or Macs that have been rumored for a fall release.
